Rhazekai.label: Draconic Organ
Rhazekai.help: Choose exactly one Draconic Organ. It grants its resistance and racial combat action for the next campaign.

options.label: Furnace Lung
options.summary: +10% Fire Resistance · Furnace Breath: 11 Base Fire damage to one enemy; 1 Burn for 2 turns.

options.label: Rime
options.summary: +10% Cold Resistance · Rime Exhalation: 8 Base Cold damage to all living enemies; damaged targets are Slowed 1 turn.

options.label: Storm
options.summary: +10% Lightning Resistance · Forked Storm: 8 Base Lightning damage to up to two different enemies.

options.label: Venom
options.summary: +10% Poison Resistance · Venom Jet: 7 Base Poison damage; 2 Poison stacks for 3 turns.

options.label: Resonance
options.summary: +10% Force Resistance · Resonant Burst: 11 Base Force damage; cannot be Blocked.

options.label: Radiant Crucible
options.summary: +5% Holy Resistance and Crucible Ray at 50% normal racial damage by default. If KI-267 Dragonblooded is equipped and bound to Holy, Radiant Crucible awakens to +10% racial Holy Resistance and full 9 Base Holy Crucible Ray damage before Dragonblooded’s own bonuses; the Ray heals the lowest-HP real ally for 40% of actual HP removed.

Veyssryn.label: SoulFire Cores
Veyssryn.help: Choose one Main Core at 1.5× benefit and exactly two different Auxiliary Cores at 0.5× benefit. All three Core types must be different.

coreOptions.label: Arc
coreOptions.summary: +8% Energy Gain; first Energy Gain calculation each combat gets +12%.

coreOptions.label: Ward
coreOptions.summary: Choose a damage type; +12% Resistance to it.

coreOptions.label: Prism
coreOptions.summary: Choose a damage type; +8% damage and +4% Damage Crit Chance with that type.

coreOptions.label: Echo
coreOptions.summary: A cooldown ability used again after its cooldown fully expires gains +10% final damage, healing, or Shield strength.

Faervani.label: Instinct
Faervani.help: Choose exactly one Faervani Instinct for the next campaign.

options.label: Hunter
options.summary: +12% Crit Chance vs enemies below 50% HP; +15% Physical damage against your most recently damaged enemy.

options.label: Flight
options.summary: +12% Dodge Chance; below 40% HP gain +6 Initiative until healed above 40%.

options.label: Pack
options.summary: Direct healing/Shields to another real ally +12%; ally hits can grant +10% final damage against that target.

options.label: Territorial
options.summary: While position has not changed since the previous turn: +15% Block Chance and +15% Blocked Damage Reduction.

options.label: Endurance
options.summary: +21% Maximum HP; numerical Exhaustion penalties are 25% weaker.

Kyravari.label: Crest Pattern
Kyravari.help: Choose exactly one Crest Pattern for the next campaign.

options.label: Spear
options.summary: Against an enemy that has not acted: +15% Physical damage and +12% Crit Chance.

options.label: Fan
options.summary: +12% Dodge Chance; successful Dodge gives +3 Initiative on your next turn.

options.label: Hook
options.summary: Against enemies below 50% HP: +15% Crit Chance and +24% Critical Damage.

options.label: Split
options.summary: +15% Dodge Chance against the first direct enemy attack each round.

options.label: Crown
options.summary: After a Crit, +18% Physical damage until the end of your next turn.

options.label: Flock
options.summary: If another real ally damaged the target this round: +18% Physical damage and +9% Crit Chance.

Rifthari.label: Manifestation
Rifthari.help: Choose exactly one Manifestation for the next campaign.

options.label: Ember
options.summary: +15% Fire Resistance; +12% Fire damage; first Fire hit can strengthen Burn.

options.label: Rime
options.summary: +15% Cold Resistance; +12% Cold damage; +10% Crit Chance vs Slowed enemies.

options.label: Storm
options.summary: +15% Lightning Resistance; +12% Lightning damage; first Energy spend grants +1 Initiative.

options.label: Stone
options.summary: +12% Physical Resistance; +10% Maximum HP; reduced displacement.

options.label: Venom
options.summary: +15% Poison Resistance; +15% Poison damage; once per enemy/combat Poison lasts +1 turn.

options.label: Distortion
options.summary: +15% Force Resistance; +12% Force damage; once/combat after being hit gain +12% Dodge until next turn end.

Demon.label: Origin + Vice
Demon.help: Choose exactly one Origin and one Vice. The pair is locked for the active campaign.

options.label: Obsession
options.summary: Consecutive turns against the same target gain +8% damage per turn, up to +24%; switching resets.

options.label: Acquisition
options.summary: First eligible enemy buff each combat is copied at 50% numerical strength for the same remaining duration.

options.label: Stagnation
options.summary: Once/combat reduce one negative numerical effect by 50% and its duration by 1; below 50% HP gain +10% Blocked Damage Reduction.

options.label: Pride
options.summary: Above 75% HP: +15% Crit Chance and +15% Critical Damage; after receiving a Crit, +20% damage vs that attacker until next turn end.

options.label: Greed
options.summary: Resource-focused Vice interactions; never creates bonus Onyx.

options.label: Lust
options.summary: Nonsexual fixation: Fixate one target for 2 turns; +12% Dodge vs it and +12% damage to it.

options.label: Envy
options.summary: Once/combat copy 75% of one eligible numerical buff for 2 turns.

options.label: Gluttony
options.summary: 50% of overhealing becomes Shield; +15% Lifesteal effectiveness.

options.label: Wrath
options.summary: For each 20% Maximum HP missing, +9% damage, up to +36%.

options.label: Sloth
options.summary: A no-damage turn builds Inertia (max 3): each stack +8% Block/+8% Blocked Damage Reduction; next damage consumes stacks for +15% damage each.

Veldrathi.summary: Debuff specialists who expose weaknesses and become more dangerous as enemies accumulate negative effects.
abilities: Faultsense: deal +6% damage to enemies suffering a negative status.
The first non-control debuff you apply each combat lasts +1 turn.
Gain +4% Crit Chance against enemies below 50% HP.
Gain +2 on checks involving weakness, illness, injury, poison, or corruption.

Exposed Fault: applying a different non-control debuff to an already-debuffed target exposes it for 2 turns. Applicable numerical debuffs from that Veldrathi are +33% stronger; this never strengthens hard control.
drawbacks: While suffering 3 or more negative effects, lose 1 Initiative.

Rhazekai.summary: Draconic Vessels whose chosen Organ grants an elemental resistance and a distinct racial combat action.
abilities: Gain +5% Maximum HP and +5% Physical Resistance.
Your selected Draconic Organ grants its listed elemental resistance and a racial combat action costing 3 Energy with a 6-turn cooldown.
Organ attacks require no weapon and use your highest final core stat for racial scaling.
drawbacks: Physical healing consumables restore 10% less HP to you.

Veyssryn.summary: SoulFire-centered beings who build their racial strengths from one Main Core and two different Auxiliary Cores.
abilities: Choose 1 Main Core at 1.5× its listed benefit and exactly 2 different Auxiliary Cores at 0.5× benefit each.
All three selected Core types must be different.
Ward and Prism require a chosen damage type when either Core is selected.
drawbacks: No separate universal racial drawback is currently listed; your racial package depends on the locked Core configuration.

Faervani.summary: Instinct-driven hunters whose chosen Instinct determines their strongest combat behavior.
abilities: Choose exactly one Instinct: Hunter, Flight, Pack, Territorial, or Endurance. The selected Instinct provides the listed racial benefits.
drawbacks: Fear and panic effects are +20% stronger against you and last +1 turn when they have a duration. This does not extend hard control unless that effect explicitly permits it.

Duvenari.summary: Dual-minded tacticians who use Waking Mind and Echo Mind to anticipate danger and prepare powerful follow-ups.
abilities: Gain +10% Psychic Resistance. The first mental debuff applied to you each combat has its duration reduced by 1 turn, to a minimum of 1.
Second Thought: twice per combat, reroll an eligible failed check, Dodge, Block, or binary defense and keep the better result.
Gain +2 on checks involving deception, motives, contradictions, patterns, or prediction, and gain +1 Initiative at combat start.

Parallel Processing: once per round after a Dodge, Block, resisted debuff, or Second Thought, gain Prepared Insight until the end of your next turn: +15% Crit Chance, +15% healing Crit Chance when healing, +20% Energy Gain, and your next non-control debuff is +25% stronger. It does not stack; a new trigger refreshes it.
drawbacks: Take +50% Psychic damage.
While suffering 2 or more mental/Psychic negative effects, Energy Gain is reduced by 75%.

Kyravari.summary: Mobile talon-fighters whose Crest Pattern rewards a specific targeting or defensive rhythm.
abilities: Gain +1 Initiative and +2% Dodge Chance.
Gain exploration utility for jumps, controlled falls, and talon-assisted movement.
Choose exactly one Crest Pattern for its listed combat benefit.
drawbacks: Kyravari do not have unrestricted combat flight.
If you voluntarily switch targets on your next turn, your offensive Crest bonus is lost for that attack.

Rifthari.summary: Elementally manifested Vessels who bind themselves to one Manifestation and can temporarily overcharge it with Scar Resonance.
abilities: Choose exactly one Manifestation: Ember, Rime, Storm, Stone, Venom, or Distortion.
Scar Resonance: once per combat for 2 turns, multiply your normal Manifestation damage and resistance bonuses by 4.
drawbacks: While Scar Resonance is active, take +25% damage from every damage type other than your Manifestation type.

Demon.summary: Demons combine one Origin with one Vice, creating a two-part racial package that rewards leaning into a specific behavior.
abilities: Choose exactly 1 Origin and 1 Vice. Their selected effects are both active for the campaign.
drawbacks: Overindulgence: after your Vice succeeds 3 times, suffer -25% Energy Gain and -10% Dodge Chance for 2 turns, then the Vice counter resets.

Halynari.summary: Crown-bearing holy Vessels with one Crown identity and the shared Ascendant Dive racial action.
abilities: Ring Crown: +18% Outgoing Healing and +12% Incoming Healing; once per combat, healing an ally below 30% HP also grants a 15% Maximum-HP Shield.
Split Crown: +18% Holy damage and +12% Holy Crit Chance; a Holy Crit makes the target take +10% Holy damage for 2 turns.
Spire Crown: +24% Energy Gain; the first ability costing 3+ Energy each combat costs 1 less, minimum 1.
Orbit Crown: when you buff another real party member, gain 50% of that buff’s numerical effect for the same duration, once per unique buff.
Thorn Crown: direct-damage retaliation deals Holy damage equal to 15% of actual HP removed and grants +10% Block Chance; Crit and damage-over-time triggers do not activate it.
Veiled Crown: +15% Holy, Dark, and Psychic Resistance; once per combat below 25% HP, become immune to new non-control debuffs until the end of your next turn.

Ascendant Dive: 5 Energy, 8-turn cooldown. Become untargetable and invulnerable to direct attacks until your next turn while existing damage-over-time continues; then strike one living enemy for 25 effective Base Holy damage before stat scaling and ordinary modifiers.
drawbacks: Crown Fracture: while suffering 3 or more negative effects, your Crown’s numerical bonuses are reduced by 50% until you drop below 3 negative effects.

Human.summary: Flexible generalists with extra starting growth, a chosen Aptitude, and emergency resilience.
abilities: Gain +2 free starting stat points.
Choose one Aptitude core stat; gain +2 on noncombat checks using it.
Gain +1 unallocated stat point at every odd Character Level starting at Level 1.
Determination: once per combat when crossing below 35% HP, gain +1 Energy, +10% Damage Reduction for 2 turns, and +10% Status Resistance for 2 turns.
Resourceful: once per campaign area, reroll one failed noncombat check and keep the better result.
drawbacks: Humans have no innate resistance, immunity, or specialized racial subsystem.

Elf.summary: Arcane-critical specialists who turn Intelligence and successful Crits into additional momentum.
abilities: Gain +1% Damage Crit Chance per 2 INT, up to +15% racial Crit Chance.
After a Crit, gain +15% Energy Gain until the end of your next turn; your next eligible damaging action also gains +10% Crit Chance. This does not stack.
Once per combat, reroll one failed Crit check; only the Crit check is rerolled.
Gain +2 on magic analysis, enchantment, and artifact checks.
drawbacks: No dedicated racial drawback is currently listed.

High Elf.summary: High-output arcane specialists with exceptional Energy, scroll, Spellbook, and eligible sword synergies.
abilities: Gain +20% Energy Gain and start combat with +1 Energy.
Gain +15% Psychic Resistance and +15% Force Resistance.
Eligible Spell Scroll numerical effects are +25% stronger.
With a Spellbook Ability Item: +15% Energy Gain, +10% magical damage, and +10% healing.
With an eligible sword: +10% Crit Chance, +15% Critical Damage, and +1 Initiative. These benefits do not bypass class restrictions.
drawbacks: Maximum HP is reduced by 8%.
Physical healing consumables restore 10% less HP.

Arbordyan.summary: Seasonal Vessels who choose Spring, Summer, Autumn, or Winter at the campsite and gain a matching passive and active package.
abilities: Spring: +25% Incoming Healing, +20% Outgoing Healing, Poison/Toxin duration -1 turn, and after healing gain +10% Dodge Chance against the next attack. Burst Bloom once per combat heals self for 15% Maximum HP, allies for 8%, and removes one eligible Poison/Toxin.

Summer: +15% damage, +3 Initiative, +15% Energy Gain. Consecutive damaging turns build Growth for +5% damage per stack, max 3. Overgrowth once per combat for 2 turns grants +20% Energy Gain, +15% damage, and +1 immediate Energy, then removes Growth.

Autumn: +12% Crit Chance, +20% Critical Damage, and +25% ordinary materials excluding Onyx, boss-only, Unique, quest, and first-clear rewards. Harvest Fruit once per combat grants +2 Energy and +15% Crit Chance until the end of your next turn.

Winter: +15% Physical Resistance, +15% Block Chance, and +15% Blocked Damage Reduction. Rooted Shell once per combat grants a 25% Maximum-HP Shield, +20% Blocked Damage Reduction for 2 turns, and displacement resistance.
Shared racial features include the approved Rootsense, Greenblood, and Sunfeeding utilities.
drawbacks: Withering: at 3 or more negative effects, seasonal passive numerical bonuses are reduced by 50% and the seasonal active is disabled until you drop below 3 negative effects.

Orc.summary: Durable front-line Vessels who build Resolve when injured and can refuse one lethal blow each combat.
abilities: Gain +12% Maximum HP, +10% Status Resistance, and take 10% less Bleed damage.
Resolve: taking actual damage grants +6% damage per stack, up to 3 stacks, for 2 turns.
Once per combat, lethal damage leaves you at 1 HP and fills Energy to your normal maximum.
drawbacks: -10% Energy Gain affects only bonus Energy Gain and never removes the guaranteed natural +1 Energy each turn.
Equipment-based Initiative bonuses are halved.

Goblin.summary: Fast scavengers who excel with consumables, Dirty Trick, material gathering, and specialized merchant bargains.
abilities: Gain +2 Initiative and +3% Dodge Chance.
The first combat consumable you use is +25% stronger and action-free; you cannot use a second consumable that turn.
Gain +1 combat consumable slot.
Dirty Trick: 0 Energy, once per combat; apply Demoralized for 2 turns and Crippled for 1 turn, then gain Fleetfoot for 1 turn.
Gain +15% additional ordinary regional materials.
Field Appraisal: ordinary materials, consumables, and field supplies cost 10% less at specialized merchants; this never discounts Onyx.
drawbacks: Maximum HP is reduced by 5%.
Heavy armor penalties are increased.

Silxered.summary: Adaptive alloy Vessels who turn recent incoming damage into resistance and are especially effective with Shields.
abilities: Gain +20% Resistance to the last direct damage type that hit you until a different direct damage type hits you.
Gain +25% Bleed Resistance.
Incoming Crits deal 10% less Critical Damage.
Shields you receive are +15% stronger and Shield decay is 25% lower.
Molt: once per combat, consume your adaptive resistance to gain a Shield equal to 20% of Maximum HP.
drawbacks: Take +20% Lightning damage; Lightning also removes your adaptive alloy resistance.
